results.description: PASS your home inspection! Contains guidelines to help you prepare for a home inspection so you can avoid delays during a real estate transaction. Shows you what a home inspector looks at when inspecting your property, and what kinds of problems he/she might find. Presents you with a checklist of items on your property to look at so you can write notes, take photos, and set the status of each item into a log. Allows you to create a To-Do List to quickly report what needs to be worked on before the inspection. Can also be used by property owners or renters before move-in and/or at move-out to track any work that needs to be done. Is simple to use.

We’ve put together a comprehensive series of checklists to help make your move a little easier. Don’t worry, we won’t let you forget a thing! Our first checklist, the Moving House Checklist has details of all the thing you’ll need to do when you move, and is customisable depending on whether you’re a first time buyer, you’re buying and/or selling, or renting your next home. Our second, the Property Viewing Checklist, details everything you need to check when you go to view a potential new home to buy. And our Change of Address Checklist outlines all the types of companies and organisations you’ll need to inform of your move. In all checklists, tasks are grouped by the stage of your move or organisation type, you can check them off as you go, and the app lets you know how many you still have left to complete. The app then generates a short list of carefully selected options designed to fit your current context. Each recommendation includes a match score and a clear explanation, so you understand why it was chosen for you. This makes it easier to decide quickly without second-guessing or switching between apps. The experience is intentionally simple: • No overwhelming feeds • No infinite scrolling • No cluttered discovery pages Just a focused way to decide what to watch. You can still explore details like cast, reviews, and trailers when needed, but these are secondary to the core decision flow. If choosing what to watch feels harder than it should, this app simplifies the process into something fast, clear, and intentional.
